search_text: published ZDI-10-033 ZDI-CAN-548 Microsoft Internet Explorer TIME2 Behavior Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-04-02 CVE-2010-0492 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-0492 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. The issue is located within the CTimeAction object. During handling of the TIME2 behavior, an attacker can trick the application into destroying the markup causing the application to reference memory that has previously been freed. Successful exploitation can lead to code execution under the context of the application. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Microsoft Internet Explorer TIME2 Behavior Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. The issue is located within the CTimeAction object. During handling of the TIME2 behavior, an attacker can trick the application into destroying the markup causing the application to reference memory that has previously been freed. Successful exploitation can lead to code execution under the context of the application.
